svg.text: Escalating the uncertain cases to the teacher buys a point or two, at most
send a prediction to the teacher when the student's max-p < τ — x = fraction escalated, y = accuracy of the pair (baseline runs, seed 0)
share of eval examples escalated to the teacher
agnews: the student alone scores 0.889 against a teacher at 0.880; escalating 9% of examples adds +1.0 points.

τ = 1.0 escalates everything and collapses onto the teacher. Source: cascade[] in results/*.json.
